signature: SUBROUTINE ZSYCONV( UPLO, WAY, N, A, LDA, IPIV, E, INFO )

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: The block diagonal matrix D and the multipliers used to obtain the factor U or L as computed by ZSYTRF.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZSYTRF.

params.name: e
params.reference: E stores the supdiagonal/subdiagonal of the symmetric 1-by-1 or 2-by-2 block diagonal matrix D in LDLT.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
